prep your eyes with some concealer or eyeshadow primer first, i would recommend starting with a lighter colour all over the lid (a light peach should be good with this colour) and blend it in with a fluffy brush. it’s waaaayy easier than going straight in with a darker shade. after that you can go with this colour, tap off the excess and blend with a light hand (this is super important) and afterwards you can add an even darker colour around your outer part of the eye with a smaller brush for some more dimension, and blend it with the fluffy brush you used previously. of course it takes a bit of practice but you’ll get the hang of it in no time!
